newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brasmotor maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brasmotor maintained as buy.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it was maintaining its buy recommendation on Brazilian home appliance firm Brasmotor for the intermediate and long-term.

-- "Brasmotor is currently in the best position to benefit from the solid fundamentals the industry is experiencing. Not only volume sales are breaking records, but costs remain under control," it said in a report.
-- It also said it rated home appliance Refripar as buy in the intermediate term and accumulate in the long-term. -- It said Refripar is the cheapest appliance maker in Brazil.
-- Merrill Lynch estimates the company to report earnings of $0.39 per ADR for the third quarter of 1996, against $0.01 per ADR in the same period last year.
-- Brasmotor preferred traded at 368 reais, up 0.01 percent, while Refripar preferred was flat at 2.45 reais at 1320 local/1520 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
